headline: Wage increases 2027: not only for those earning the minimum wage. Who can expect a higher gross and take-home pay next year
summary: The 2027 national minimum wage will be 4,950 zloty gross, or 3,704 zloty take-home. The increase is expected to trigger pay rises for other employees in companies that link raises to it.
why: Minimum wage changes set a floor for labour costs and wage inflation, affecting employers, consumer spending, and central bank assessments of inflation.
